The issuer exhibits moderate profitability with an operating margin of 13.5% and a return on assets of 7.2%, but faces significant financial risk due to high leverage (a debt-to-equity ratio driven by total liabilities of $4,392M against equity of $941M) and a weak liquidity profile indicated by a current ratio below 1.0 (0.91). While the company remains profitable and generates substantial revenue, its balance sheet stretch and working capital deficit place it at the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
